release_intent: Make the private Hermes home reproducible enough for trusted operators while preserving local-only runtime and secret boundaries.

stable_requires: changed scripts compile and targeted tests pass
install-same-experience runbook updated when installer surface changes
no live config, secrets, DBs, locks, cron outputs, or credentials are newly tracked

publishable_surfaces.skills: Procedural memory and reusable workflows under skills/.
publishable_surfaces.scripts: Local automation, validators, doctors, schedulable scripts, and tests under scripts/.
publishable_surfaces.project_profiles: Durable project profiles under project-profiles/ with no secrets.
publishable_surfaces.workflows: SSOTs, architecture docs, verification evidence, and local implementation slices under workflows/.
publishable_surfaces.docs_private: Private but durable evidence, architecture, and release notes under docs/private/.
publishable_surfaces.hermes_agent_submodule: Pinned upstream/private runtime checkout pointer; runtime code changes belong in the child repo first.
publishable_surfaces.hewos: Embodied workflow OS implementation and tests under workflows/projects/hermes-embodied-workflow-os/.
publishable_surfaces.dynamic_selfcheck: Dynamic coverage control plane under scripts/dynamic_selfcheck_coverage.py and matching tests/docs.

install_same_experience_layers.activation: Install official Hermes Agent and run hermes doctor.
Copy/import skills and verify skill listing.
Copy scripts, run py_compile and targeted doctors.
Install project-profiles/*.json and verify referenced paths are adapted.
Install selected workflows/ projects; read-only by default.
Create local-only no-agent jobs from runbooks; success-silent by default.
Requires platform credentials, exact target allowlist, send/readback tests.
Requires exact device, rollback, safety gate, dry-run, and readback.

authority_boundaries.local_write: Allowed only for target ~/.hermes install with backup/receipt.
authority_boundaries.scheduled_jobs: Install disabled or local-only; no external delivery by default.
authority_boundaries.external_send: Closed until exact platform/target/payload/readback authority exists.
authority_boundaries.push_deploy_publish: Closed until explicit repo/branch/rollback/readback authority exists.
authority_boundaries.destructive: Closed until exact resource, backup/restore, receipt, and readback exist.
authority_boundaries.secrets_payments: Human-only entry; never type or store secrets in repo.
